'''October 2001 Phoenix tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Gamer's Edge, Phoenix, AZ on 10 October 2001. [[Hayes Hunter]] won it. It is known from Hayes Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3047">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-11-dpc-phoenix-epilogued3047/ dpc-phoenix-epilogue], DeckTech (Hayes "Hayes" Hunter, 11 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-11-dpc-phoenix-epilogued3047/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 10 October 2001
* '''Site:''' Gamer's Edge, Phoenix, AZ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Hayes Hunter]]

== Tournament reports ==

Players' own reports from this event.

* [[Hayes Hunter DPC Phoenix Epilogue (tournament report)]] — by [[Hayes Hunter]], 1st, 4–0
* [[Robert Dayton Phoenix AZ 10-10 (tournament report)]] — by [[Robert Dayton]], second to last, 1–3
* [[Robert Dayton Phoenix 10-10 Things Left Unsaid (tournament report)]] — by [[Robert Dayton]], second to last, 1–3

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Hayes Hunter gives his two wins over Robert Dayton as FW +22 (Dayton drew up) and FW +7; Dayton's own report gives those games as losses by 7 and by 24.<ref name="tr-d3047" />
* Dayton gives his two games against Hayes Hunter as losses by 7 and by 24; Hunter's report gives them as wins by 22 (Dayton drew up) and by 7.<ref name="tr-d3051" />
